name: reflex
description: Browse-fast Plex client for an LG OLED B8 (webOS 4.0)

scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run smoke
scripts.crew:setup: git config core.hooksPath .claude/crew/githooks && echo 'commit hook enabled'
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm run package && ares-install -d ${TV:-tv} *.ipk && ares-launch -d ${TV:-tv} com.stu.plexlite
